facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 58°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Stevens Pass (3,940 ft) and Trinity (2,890 ft) 7 to 15 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: left May 7; earlier seasons: May 21 (2023), May 24 (2024), May 22 (2025)

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: May 13 (2023), May 8 (2024), May 7 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Stevens Pass (3,940 ft) and Trinity (2,890 ft).

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: 23.6 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 40.0 in (2023), 30.2 in (2024), 32.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: 20.1 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 26.9 in (2023), 21.3 in (2024), 26.3 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 20 and June 15, carried from the melt-out dates at Stevens Pass (3,940 ft) and Trinity (2,890 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 7, 296 ft below the pass; points to April 18 to June 5

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: melted out May 1, 1,346 ft below the pass; points to April 23 to June 25
